intro:
Manchester has built the UK's most convincing second tech economy: the BBC and ITV anchor MediaCityUK, global banks run northern technology centres here, and the city's startup scene scales on lower costs than London with talent from four universities. Public-sector relocations — including major government hubs — add programme roles continuously. Northern employers fund certification because it anchors the salary uplift the region's tech boom is producing; PMP and Scrum credentials both feature in Manchester job adverts routinely. We run live online cohorts throughout the year on Manchester-friendly hours — weekend Saturday–Sunday batches and midweek Wednesday–Thursday batches both — meaning learners in Manchester attend at ordinary local times, never overnight; the table below shows each upcoming date converted for Manchester. Afterwards you get structured exam application support, realistic mock exams, and open access to the trainer for questions until you're certified.

Manchester carries the North's largest concentration of project work: media and broadcasting around MediaCity, a fast-compounding tech scene, and the public-sector relocations that moved serious program budgets out of London. Employers here compete for a smaller certified pool than the capital's, which makes the credential proportionally louder on a Manchester CV. Training is live online over two days in UK hours — no Piccadilly commute, no leave. Northern salaries trail London less than folklore suggests, especially for certified roles; check the sourced Manchester entries below for the actual spread. The employer list reflects the media-tech-public mix that hires certified project talent here, and private cohorts suit organizations building delivery capability outside the capital.

faq.a: All batches are 100% live online, taught by an instructor over video with interactive exercises — there is no venue to travel to in Manchester. You need a laptop, a stable connection and a free weekend.
